claims.summary: For alpha_1, alpha_2 in [1, infinity] with 1/alpha_1 + 1/alpha_2 >= 1/2, X and Y independent samples of N uniform points of [0,1]^2, s_1 = sqrt(log N/N), c >= 2, integer levels 1 = k_1 < ... < k_I with k_(i+1) <= (c-1) k_i + 1 and k_I >= log N/(4c), L'' >= max(c^(max beta) L_1, (4c)^(max beta) K_0) (L_1 the constant of thm:per-level-count-matchings, K_0 that of thm:maximum-displacement-curve-threshold) and G_i the pairs with |X^j - Y^j| <= L'' k_i^(beta_j) s_1 for j = 1, 2, G_(I+1) complete: if with probability tending to one every maximum matching of every G_i has a matching of G_(i+1) inside its leftover with m_i - m_(i+1) edges, then with probability tending to one some matching meets the conjecture's condition at alpha with the constant 2 L'' (on the curve, conj:ultimate-matching at alpha); the integer levels are c = 2.
claims.assessment: Working proof of a conditional statement, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer (research/results/ultimate_matching_box_completion_20261018/review.txt): the levels with k_i >= log N/(4c) have m_i = 0 on the event of thm:maximum-displacement-curve-threshold; below, m_i <= V_(c k_i) with E V_t <= delta_N 2N e^(-t) from the proof of thm:per-level-count-matchings, so the deficiency sum with weights e^(k_(i+1)) - e^(k_i) is o(N) in mean and at most N with probability tending to one; thm:local-completion-dichotomy (f)'s proof gives a perfect matching with |P - G_i| <= m_i, then sum e^(k_i*) <= (1+e)N and Jensen at constant 2L''.
claims.rationale: Makes universal completion at box levels of bounded ratio the whole question on the gluing route: the conjecture at every pair of the curve follows from it.
claims.next_action: Prove that, for every fixed L'' and ratio, the failure certificate fires with probability bounded below along a subsequence, which would close the gluing route through (f).

claims.summary: For nested bipartite graphs G <= G' with nu(G') > nu(G), D_Y (D_X) the Y- (X-) vertices missed by some maximum matching of G, B_X the X-vertices with a G'-neighbour in D_Y and B_Y the Y-vertices with a G'-neighbour in D_X: if B_X or B_Y is matchable in G, some maximum matching of G has a leftover spanning no edge of G', so universal completion with C = 1 fails; if nu(G'[D_X u D_Y]) < nu(G') - nu(G), completion with C = 1 fails for every maximum matching.
claims.assessment: Working proof, passed in two passes of one medium reviewer: a matchable B_X extends to a basis of the transversal matroid, the X-cover of a maximum matching, whose Y-leftover lies in D_Y; every leftover lies in D_X u D_Y.
claims.rationale: A polynomial certificate that a gluing hypothesis fails on a given instance.
claims.next_action: Its asymptotics at the goal's box levels, the item's next attempt.

claims.summary: At (4,4), X uniform and Y evenly spread, box graphs at L k^(1/4) sqrt(log N/N): at L = 1/2, in nine of nine samples of N = 4096, 16384 and 65536 points, the level-1 graph is deficient (m_1 from 56 to 430) and the failure certificate fires at level 1, so universal completion fails there (in one sample completion fails for every maximum matching); between levels 1 and c in {2, 4, 8, 16}, in 24 of 24 cases at N = 4096 and 16384; at L = 1 the level-1 graph has a perfect matching in nine of nine samples and no level drops.
claims.assessment: Finite check, passed with corrections in two passes of one medium reviewer: compiled Hopcroft-Karp kernel checked against networkx on 200 graphs; certificate sound on 1800 tiny instances checked by brute force (research/results/ultimate_matching_box_completion_20261018/); the level-ratio run exploratory.
claims.rationale: Tests the sufficiency's hypothesis at reachable sizes: it fails at a small constant and is vacuous at L = 1.
claims.next_action: None at larger sizes: the asymptotic question goes by proof.
